summary: Phase 6.2 multi-procedure consent + surgery backend tests — ALL 6/6 PASSED. Verified POST /api/surgical-consents with procedure_keys[] returns correct procedure_key (first), procedure_keys (full list), procedure_snapshots (list of templates each with name.en, procedure.en, specific_risks, alternatives), and procedure_snapshot (back-compat = first snapshot). Legacy single procedure_key path still works (procedure_keys auto-derived as [key], 1 snapshot). Invalid key returns 400 'Unknown procedure key'. Surgeries POST stores procedure_keys correctly; legacy single-key flow auto-defaults procedure_keys to [procedure_key]. GET /api/surgical-consents/{cid} returns both list fields intact.
critical_code_review_comments: surgical_consents.py:134 — when body.procedure_keys is empty list AND body.procedure_key is also empty/None, code will append None to keys then 400 on lookup. Acceptable since procedure_key is required in ConsentCreate (Field(...)), but worth a note.

surgeries.py:97 — procedure_keys defaults to None when both body.procedure_keys is None AND body.procedure_key is None. Behaviour ok for fully-legacy logbook rows that don't supply either, but worth confirming downstream consumers (PDF/UI) handle None.
